newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Movilnet wins a round in row with govt.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Movilnet wins a round in row with govt.

text.p: Venezuela's cellular phone operators have been allowed to resume signing up more customers, but a regulatory source says one company, Movilnet, may face a fresh ban.
Movilnet, a subsidiary of national telephone company CANTV, last week won an injunction lifting the initial order, arguing the ban violated its right to freedom of commerce.

"If they (Movilnet) continue with their writs and spend all their profits on lawyers, that's one thing," a source at the government telecommunications agency Conatel said Tuesday. "But we won't stop in our defense of the customer."
Conatel's ban, imposed on July 18 ban, followed a barrage of complaints about poor service and overbilling by Movilnet and its competitor TelCel.
TelCel, which was allowed to resume selling new lines on Monday, was unlikely to face a fresh ban, the source said. The injunction, handed down on Friday, applied only to Movilnet.
